hooks.name: Run pytest on tracer/test save
hooks.description: When a file in frontend/src/py/ or tests/ is saved, run the pytest suite and report failures.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 1; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/pytest ]; then echo "pytest hook: .venv/bin/pytest not found. Create it with: uv venv .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements-dev.txt" >&2; exit 1; fi; out=$(.venv/bin/pytest -q --tb=short -rf 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "pytest FAILED (exit $code)"; echo "$out" | tail -40; echo "pytest FAILED (exit $code), see output above" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "pytest passed: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)"
